usage:

evidence.reason: After edit, scheduledDelay calls reminders.reset() then reminders.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benchmark") and returns reminders.historySize(), discarding the minutes argument and no longer dividing by reminderUnit.

After edit, reminderDelay returns 0 immediately when minutes===0, so any evaluate(0,...) path that delegates to reminderDelay will not produce a positive delay or populate history via the normal computation.

Tests assert evaluate(20,0.1,"work")>0, historySize()>0, and scheduledDelay(40)>0; the merged behavior of scheduledDelay(40) now depends on evaluate(0,...) and historySize(), which is not covered by the supplied evidence.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改合并后，scheduledDelay 改为用 0 分钟调用 evaluate 并返回 historySize，而 reminderDelay 对 0 分钟直接返回 0，可能破坏测试所依赖的“evaluate 产生正值且 historySize>0”的行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay，恢复传入真实 minutes（如 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work")）并返回其计算结果，而不是用 0 调用 evaluate 后返回 historySize()。
